productionActivation: off: the runner plays the aggregate adapter (playAggregate) directly; no world activates the model

clubTopScorerShare.label: club top scorer's share of its league goals (mean over clubs)

leagueTopScorerGoals.label: the league top scorer's goals in a 38-round season

settings.forcedTactics: tactic pairings force both tactics on the core pairs with each club's squad built for its forced formation (grid-bands forcedRosters, the detailed runner's rule) and start both squads from NEUTRAL_SQUAD_FATIGUE; the XI is rated at the formation it plays, the profiles and possession chance follow the tactics played
settings.fatigue: fatigue conditions set every matchday player of both sides to the pre-match fatigue
settings.knockouts: target counts and durations of a match with extra time are read per 90 minutes played (TargetBand.perNinety)

detailedOnlyRows.reason: MATCH-23: reads ball positions or possession sequences, which bind the detailed engine only (MATCH-26)

unbanded.fieldTilt: between equal sides it is 50% by construction (each side's share of both sides' final-third passes), so a level band says nothing; held to parity
unbanded.lineBreakingPasses: needs every opponent line's deepest player at each pass: public event data (StatsBomb, Wyscout) carries no line membership or full positions, and FIFA's published line breaks are tournament counts under its own line set; held to parity

coverage.status: not measured: century careers need 100-season worlds (T285/T286 century runs)

againstArtifact.note: Point differences (aggregate − detailed) of the target readings on the same condition fixtures and seeds; the detailed artifact may come from another source tree, so this is context for T286, not MATCH-28 equivalence.
